Time to Live (TTL)

An 8-bit IPv4 field decremented by 1 at each router hop. If TTL reaches 0, the packet is discarded to prevent endless routing loops.

TCP 3-Way Handshake

Establishes connection before transmitting payload: Client sends SYN, Server responds SYN-ACK, Client confirms ACK.

TCP Retransmission (RTO)

If a TCP packet drops and no ACK returns before the Retransmission Timeout, the sender automatically re-sends missing packets.
